sections.title: Exact actual source and the fixed-history convention
sections.proof:
Keep the actual native K=3 even/odd family, full norms, physical normalization and every prime-power/Arch/pole channel of the corrected seam audit. Set Xe=L^9 Qe/Ce, Xo=L^7 Qo/Co, Ce=720^2(2pi)^8=36pi^2 Co, and F=Xe''+Xo. This report does not replace the source by arbitrary exponential coefficients. Its input is the independently reviewed COMPLETE actual all-zero equality, with multiplicities and both reflected halves:
 Xe(L)=2 sum_p m_p b(p)(exp(pL)-1)r_p(L),
 b(p)=(1/4-p^2)^2/p^14,
 r_p(L)=product_(n=1)^3(1+(2pi n/(pL))^2)^(-2).
Here p=rho-1/2 runs over all actual shifted zeros. The current strip, conjugation/one-sub symmetry, nonreal-zero theorem and inverse-square summability give a fixed eta>0 with |Im p|>=eta, 0<=Theta=sup Re p<=1/2, and all coefficient masses used below finite. No maximum of Re p is assumed. Choose ONCE L0>max(1,12pi/eta). Define the actual history
 P(L)=integral_(L0)^L Xe(t)dt.
This lower endpoint is never reset at a well. Thus P'=Xe exactly, and all pre-well history after L0 is retained. Choosing a different fixed L0 changes a fixed source constant, not the argument or the original response.

The principal quantitative estimate below is stated under an actual off-line zero, hence Theta>0. This premise is already necessary for the proposed late negative-well route. Constants may depend on this actual Theta and the fixed source, but are fixed BEFORE the choice of any well. No estimate uniform as Theta decreases to0 is claimed. The exact integration identities themselves need no off-line premise.

sections.title: Uniform full-source primitive reduction with one further aperture power
sections.proof:
Put a*=36pi^2 and c=112pi^2. As a function of z=1/(p^2 L^2), r=product_n(1+(2pi n)^2 z)^(-2) is holomorphic in |z|<1/a*. On |z|=1/(2a*) its absolute value is at most64. Cauchy's coefficient bound therefore gives, uniformly for |a*z|<=1/4,
 r=1-c/(p^2 L^2)+epsilon_p,
 |epsilon_p|<=512 a*^2 |p|^-4 L^-4,
 |epsilon_p'|<=4096 a*^2 |p|^-4 L^-5,
 |epsilon_p''|<=32768 a*^2 |p|^-4 L^-6.
The derivatives are in real L. For completeness, if q=2a*|z|<=1/2, the last two estimates use sum_(j>=2)j q^j<=8q^2 and sum_(j>=2)j(2j+1)q^j<=64q^2. These estimates cover the ENTIRE zero family; the small denominator condition is paid by L0 and eta.

Define real source quantities
 C0=2 sum_p m_p b(p),    C2=2 sum_p m_p p^2 b(p),
 V1(L)=2 sum_p m_p b(p)exp(pL)/p,
 Bj=2 sum_p m_p |b(p)| |p|^(-j), j=-2,0,1,2,3,4.
Conjugation makes C0,C2,V1 real. C0 and C2 are retained with their actual signs, which are not assumed here. Normal convergence and the uniform remainder give
 Xe=V1'-C0+delta,
 |delta(L)|<=D(exp(Theta L)+1)/L^2,
 F=C2+4c L^-3 V1+R0,
 |R0(L)|<=A/L^2+B exp(Theta L)/L^4.                       (W2.1)
Explicit safe choices are Cr=32768 a*^2,
 D=c B2+Cr B4,
 A=c B0+(Cr+6c)B2+Cr B4,
 B=6c B2+2Cr B3+Cr B4.
Indeed the exact identity is
 F=2 sum_p m_p b(p)[p^2 r_p-r_p''+exp(pL)(2p r_p'+r_p'')].
The first part differs from C2 by O(L^-2). In the exponential part, 2p r_p' has leading4c/(p L^3), while r_p'' contributes -6c/(p^2 L^4). These are source terms, not discarded remainders justified by cancellation.

The primitive comparison is exact:
 V1(L)-P(L)=C0(L-L0)+V1(L0)-integral_(L0)^L delta(t)dt.
Let T=max(L0,4/Theta), E=integral_(L0)^T |delta| and
 V*=|V1(L0)-C0 L0|+E+D/T.
For L>=T, derivative[exp(Theta t)/t^2]>=(Theta/2)exp(Theta t)/t^2 on t>=T, hence
 |V1-P|<=|C0|L+V*+(2D/Theta)exp(Theta L)/L^2.
It follows that the SAME complete source obeys
 F(L)=C2+448pi^2 L^-3 P(L)+R(L),
 |R(L)|<=A*/L^2+B*exp(Theta L)/L^4,                      (W2.2)
where A*=A+4c|C0|+4cV*, B*=B+8cD/Theta are safe. Here R is DEFINED by the exact displayed equality; the bound is proved, not an assumed source budget. All constants are fixed before the well. No early source interval, constant channel, negative square, normal, or prime power is dropped. This improves the remaining exponential allowance by one aperture power after the actual primitive has been extracted; it does not make the remainder relatively small against arbitrary cofinal exp(alpha L) excursions with alpha<Theta.

sections.title: Actual negative-well storage and the entry-history cost
sections.proof:
Let [A,B] lie beyond T and be a bounded negative well of Xe: Xe(A)=Xe(B)=0 and Xe<0 on (A,B). Write w=-Xe=-P'>0 and define the nonnegative storage
 H(L)=224pi^2 L^-3 P(L)^2.
The actual seam regularity already paid in the companion report is more than enough for the following ordinary integration by parts, including across prime-power seams:
 integral_A^B w F
   =C2 integral_A^B w +H(A)-H(B)
      -672pi^2 integral_A^B L^-4 P(L)^2 dL
      +integral_A^B w R.                                  (W3.1)
Thus SAME arithmetic generation does yield a signed favorable bulk. It is accompanied by the exact entry storage H(A); setting P(A)=0 would change F and erase a real history term.

Combining the exact well identity integral w Xo=integral wF-integral|w'|^2 yields, if there is no simultaneous negative parity on this well (so Xo>=0),
 integral |w'|^2+H(B)+672pi^2 integral L^-4 P^2
 <=H(A)+C2 integral w+integral wR.                         (W3.2)
The residual in this expression has the explicit source-fixed bound (W2.2). This is a necessary cost on the actual complete response, not an independently supplied upper bound or a new conditional RH criterion. In particular C2 integral w and H(A) cannot be omitted, nor may the bound exp(Theta L)/L^4 be called rapid or small compared with exp(alpha L).

sections.title: Why summing actual wells does not telescope away history
sections.proof:
For any finite ordered disjoint collection of bounded actual negative wells [Aj,Bj],
 sum_j[H(Aj)-H(Bj)]
 =H(A1)-H(Bm)+sum_(j<m)[H(A_(j+1))-H(Bj)].
Every intervening term is exactly
 integral_(Bj)^(A_(j+1)) [448pi^2 L^-3 P(L)Xe(L)-672pi^2 L^-4 P(L)^2]dL.
For consecutive wells the intervening response is nonnegative apart from possible zeros. Its product with the complete earlier primitive P still has no established sign. These terms are the replenishment of history; they are not absent boundary terms. Passing to infinitely many wells would additionally require convergence of the displayed endpoint/interval sums. No such convergence is inserted here.

The older source-pair Green identity already shows the analogous danger: removing true homogeneous pieces pays internal seams but leaves a full source forcing and outer boundary. Its positive bulk/integrability damping gap is not repaired merely by this different primitive. The complete causal Selberg energy similarly retains finite-history terms. The present new extraction gives the precise actual scalar entry cost and one extra inverse-aperture power, rather than claiming that those older full forcing terms have vanished.

sections.title: The precise failure of a Fourier-gap shortcut for this well weight
sections.proof:
The actual zero ordinate gap |Im p|>=eta is used correctly in W2 to expand the rational multiplier. It does NOT give a Fourier spectral gap for a restricted actual negative-well weight. For any a>=0 let y(L)=1_[A,B](L)exp(-aL)w(L). This is a nonzero nonnegative compactly supported function, so its ordinary Fourier transform satisfies
 yhat(0)=integral_A^B exp(-aL)w(L)dL>0.
By continuity it has nonzero low-frequency content on a neighborhood of0. This is a direct fact about the hypothesized ACTUAL well, not an arbitrary exponential model. Therefore a Parseval argument asserting Fourier support outside (-eta,eta) for y is false. Multiplication by a window and taking a negative part do not preserve the zero-family frequency restriction; off-line exponential factors already prevent the naive whole-line L2 interpretation.

The exact damped identity is instead
 integral_A^B exp(-2aL)w Xo
 =integral_A^B exp(-2aL)wF -integral_A^B |y'|^2+a^2 integral_A^B y^2.
The only automatic interval bound here is integral|y'|^2>=(pi/(B-A))^2 integral y^2, not eta^2 times that norm. A useful upper bound on the actual well width, or another independently proved source-dependent inequality, would be needed to turn this damped identity into the proposed coercivity. Whole-half-line damping a>Theta can make the actual complete source integrable and bound a causal primitive, but it neither removes these well boundaries nor supplies that width estimate. The countercheck above refutes the spectral-support premise; it does not assert that every numerical eta-Poincare inequality fails for the actual wells.

sections.title: Bounded research outcome and exact authority
sections.proof:
The new source-specific deduction is W2.2-W3.2: a nonnegative complete-history storage, a favorable signed bulk, and a quantitatively smaller residual derived from the full shared zero source. This goes beyond the prior termwise sign tests and uses no arbitrary coefficient replacement. The remaining costs are the actual history entering each well, its replenishment across intervening intervals, the full constant channel and the still-exponential residual. No current ground, contact, first-birth or source-normalization identity independently bounds these costs for this varying-aperture response. Fixed-K native ground constraints cannot be relabelled as a Fourier support theorem for w.

No simultaneous negative pair, independent signed upper bound, all-L positivity, Step4 or RH closure follows. Existing formal statements and production inventories are unchanged. This is DERIVED external analysis from the reviewed complete K3 equality and current source interfaces, not a new Lean theorem or compiler/CI result. No source quadrature, zero truncation, numerical fit, new proof build or repository edit was performed. The next informative mathematical comparison is an independently paid control of the actual storage/replenishment or the signed residual on these same wells, rather than a repeated termwise sign assumption.
